description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application, rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It initializes the React application, sets up strict mode for better error detection, and includes necessary imports for React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
